provenance.citation: Havelund, K., & Rosu, G. (2001). Monitoring Programs Using Rewriting. Proceedings of ASE 2001 (16th IEEE International Conference on Automated Software Engineering), 135-143.
provenance.locus: Section 4 (formula rewriting / progression semantics) and Section 2 (finite-trace LTL semantics); the safety-property monitoring style is their traffic-controller class of examples.
provenance.notes: The paper defines monitoring by progression (formula rewriting per event) with finite-trace end-of-trace evaluation: G phi holds on a finite trace iff phi holds at every event (good prefix). Fixture encodes a traffic-light mutual-exclusion safety property G (red -> !green): satisfied on the conforming trace, violated at exactly the event where red and green hold together.
